title: Symmetric AES-GCM Authenticated Encryption
description: Tests direct JCA Cipher instantiation with AES in GCM mode without padding.

expected_findings.evaluation_notes: Scanners must extract AES algorithm, GCM mode, and NoPadding. Operational role is determinable as encryption_decryption based on Cipher API and ENCRYPT_MODE. GCM tag length note: The fixture specifies a 128-bit authentication tag (TAG_LENGTH_BITS = 128). Schema limitation: answer_key.schema.json does not define a tag_length_bits parameter property, so this parameter is documented here rather than modifying the schema casually.

verification_metadata.verification_method: Manual Source Code Inspection & JCA Spec Cross-Check
